RagShortTexts: Petra (Raqmu) (佩特拉) was a pivotal fortified settlement, anchoring regional military logistics and urban commerce throughout ancient Mediterranean conflicts.

Variants.Content: Capital of the Nabataean kingdom, Petra ('The Rock', Semitic Raqmu) is concealed within narrow sandstone chasms reached through the winding Siq gorge. Renowned for rock-cut facades like the Treasury (Al-Khazneh) carved into living pink cliffs and secret ceramic pipeline cisterns, it levies immense transit taxes on eastern caravan routes.

The ramparts of Petra (Raqmu) must fly the eagle standard! Whether through engineering circumvallation or direct assault, Rome ensures this fortress serves senatorial order and secures our communication lines!

The markets of Petra (Raqmu) belong to free maritime trade, not Roman chains! Carthage supports its autonomy against legionary oppression, guaranteeing that Punic gold and spears will reinforce its ramparts!
